articles.summary: Rockwell Medical, Inc. (the "Company") (Nasdaq: RMTI), a healthcare company that develops, manufactures, commercializes, and distributes a portfolio of hemodialysis products to dialysis providers worldwide, today announced that the Company is exhibiting its hemodialysis concentrates portfolio in Booth #1049 at the American Society of Nephrology ("ASN") Kidney Week 2026 , which will be held October 21-25 at the Colorado Convention Center in Denver, CO. More information about Rockwell Medical's hemodialysis concentrates product portfolio can be found on the Company's website: www.rockwellmed.com/hemodialysis-products . articles.summary: Third consecutive annual recognition reflects Rockwell Medical’s continued investment in its people, commitment to quality, and cultural development Rockwell Medical, Inc. (the "Company") (Nasdaq: RMTI), a healthcare company that develops, manufactures, commercializes, and distributes a portfolio of hemodialysis products to dialysis providers worldwide, today announced that Great Place to Work ® and Fortune magazine named Rockwell Medical No. 16 out of 50 on the 2026 Fortune Best Workplaces in Manufacturing ProductionTM List in the small medium category. This marks the third consecutive year that Rockwell Medical has earned this recognition—climbing from No. 50 on the list in 2024 and No. 40 on the list in 2025—underscoring the Company’s continued progress in building an employee-validated culture where people are central to its success, understand the impact of their work, and have opportunities to contribute and grow.
